h1: AI UGC Video Ads for Health and Fitness Brands
eyebrow: Skip the Creator for This Ad
lead: Put the teal mat, the breakfast bottle, or the bands in a morning routine for a health and fitness UGC video. An avatar stands in, so you skip booking a creator.
card: Short routine clips for the teal mat, the breakfast bottle, and the bands.

faq.q: Can the photo or clip show what a supplement does?
faq.a: No. Show how and when it is used, not a health result. Keep claims and dosage in text your team approves.

faq.q: Why does the label look washed out?
faq.a: Shoot the bottle upright, front label centered, with soft side light instead of a direct flash. Glare usually starts in that source photo.

faq.q: Can I use these in paid wellness ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, so you can use them in paid ads. Any health claim or offer you add has to be accurate.

faq.q: Do I need a model or a creator?
faq.a: No. Pick an AI avatar from 53 actors. The clip can include a spoken line and captions. Hire a real person only when you need a true customer story.

faq.q: Can I make a Story from this?
faq.a: Yes. A square photo fits a feed or a product page. For a phone Story, make a tall clip at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

A 6-second clip spends 24 credits, 10 seconds spends 40, 15 seconds spends 60, and 30 seconds spends 120. A still spends 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the number before you start. If the clip fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Which shapes can a clip use?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a square, 16:9 for a wide page, and 4:3 or 3:4 when the page asks for them.
Avoid before-and-after bodies, medical outcomes, and dosage text inside the image. Show the product in a routine, and write the claims where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send that link from your own shop through the API. Ask for a short script and pick an AI avatar. Make a few versions, including one in another language, then trim the clip in the editor. Add a voice, captions, and a music track before you post it.

steps_h2: How to Make Wellness Product Photos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You download a routine photo of the teal yoga mat that you can post, without booking a creator.

steps.d: Unroll the teal yoga mat so the full mat is visible. That photo is the product in the morning routine.
Pick an AI avatar who looks like someone about to stretch beside that mat.
Download the routine clip for the feed you already use. It can include a spoken voice and captions.

steps.sourceAlt: Teal yoga mat partly unrolled on a clean studio floor.
steps.prompt: An adult starts a gentle stretch beside a teal yoga mat on a bright studio floor. The full mat stays visible, and the scene shows no body change.
